global_event_rule: Consecutive admitted events after the imported checkpoint; fixed class set; exactly one class replacement per commit.

adapter_policy.initial: Fresh native keygen produces canonical zero ciphertext. All declared classes start empty at event0.
adapter_policy.scope: Plaintext E5 encoder, local authorization/FIFO/adapter and full BFV reader are trusted. Native proof covers ciphertext arithmetic, not these application semantics.
adapter_policy.update: Use installed class accumulator; old is canonical zero while count<8, otherwise oldest committed input; fresh input is issued from new plaintext text encoding.
adapter_policy.visibility: Only journal-committed class heads and receipt-derived queues are queryable; staged candidates never supply a successful teach/query result.

provenance.zero_scope: Native keygen canonical difference fresh-fresh; initial zero checkpoint is trusted application setup, not a proved old model history.

protocol_scope: Local caller authorization and genesis selection, ciphertext/descriptor parsers, native verifier adapter and durable parent/commit logic are TCB. No confidentiality or hostile-OS claim.

randomness_rule.arithmetic: deterministic canonical BFV acc+fresh-old; no new arithmetic randomness or rerandomization
randomness_rule.fresh_ciphertext: external trusted learner encryption; randomness quality is not proved by this relation
randomness_rule.proof: portable public preprocessing; witness hiding commitments generated with OS randomness by the prover; freshness not certified by verification

reader_scope: Existing full BFV reader survives. Declared keyID/recipient equality is protocol metadata, not ciphertext key-membership proof or restricted release.
relation: Lean-generated canonical NTT BFV acc+fresh-old; 8192 rows, 57 columns, 16384 RNS equations
